Chinese Official Sentenced to Death for Spying and Leaking Secrets

A Chinese official has been sentenced to death for spying and leaking state secrets. The official was found guilty of handing over more than 100 intelligence reports and receiving over $150,000 in payoffs from a foreign intelligence agency. State media reported the sentencing, which involved the leak of 35 state secrets.
